benefits.label: Why it works
benefits.title: Why Syla Slova?
benefits.item_1_body: 13 lessons on media literacy and manipulation recognition woven into a thriller plot. Kids learn to spot lies — and think they're just playing a detective game.
benefits.item_2_body: Every decision moves the story forward. The interactive format keeps engagement high through meaningful choices, not memorisation.
benefits.item_3_body: No ads, no toxic content, no dark patterns. A full parental dashboard lets you track every critical thinking skill your child masters.

how_it_works.label: The learning process
how_it_works.title: How it works
how_it_works.subtitle: Four components that turn theory into a real skill
how_it_works.step_1_body: 13 interactive episodes of 'City of Broken Words'. Your child makes choices — each one hides a lesson on critical thinking.
how_it_works.step_2_body: Two 40-minute sessions per week with a tutor in small groups. Online or in-person — your choice.
how_it_works.step_3_body: A parent dashboard shows exactly which of the 13 critical thinking skills your child has mastered.
how_it_works.step_4_body: A fixed 26-lesson programme. At the end — a lasting critical thinking skill, not a one-off effect.

why_now.label: Why it matters
why_now.title: Why this matters right now
why_now.subtitle: Information hygiene is a survival skill, not optional
why_now.body: Children aged 10–12 today consume more videos and messages than adults did a decade ago. Fake news, manipulation and social media algorithms are a constant threat — and most kids have no defence.
why_now.card_1_body: Believes everything they see. Never asks who made it or why.
why_now.card_2_body: Peer pressure, pushy ads, scary chain messages — all work on them.
why_now.card_3_body: Falls back on emotions or goes silent. Can't defend their own opinion.
why_now.card_4_body: Kids are asked to memorize, not think. "Where did you get that?" is rarely asked.

parents.page_title: For Parents — Syla Slova | Critical Thinking Course for Kids
parents.page_description: Why does your child need critical thinking right now? 26 lessons, 13 skills, 3 months. Free first lesson, no obligations.
parents.hero_title: Your child will learn to think — not just follow
parents.hero_subtitle: 3 months · 26 lessons · 13 critical thinking skills that stay for life.
parents.why_title: Your child sees more content in one week than you saw in an entire year
parents.why_stat: A child aged 10–12 today consumes more video and messages than an adult did 10 years ago. And the ability to think critically is no longer optional — it's a survival skill.
parents.problem_1_body: Believes everything they see without questioning the author's motivation.
parents.problem_2_body: Susceptible to peer pressure, advertising and fear-based messages with no resistance.
parents.problem_3_body: Resorts to emotions or goes silent instead of defending a position with evidence.
parents.problem_4_body: Education focuses on memorisation, not critical analysis. 'How do you know that?' is rarely asked.
parents.course_title: Two superpowers your child will gain
parents.power_1_body: Recognising populism, concept substitution and emotional manipulation. Understanding the difference between evidence-based persuasion and manipulative techniques.
parents.power_2_body: Resisting peer pressure and authority. Saying 'no' without guilt. Recognising fear as a tool of influence.
parents.curriculum_subtitle: Once a week, 2 × 40 min. Each session has a matching game level.
parents.session_05_a: What are we actually arguing about?
parents.session_08_a: When they try to scare us
parents.faq_1_q: From what age can children join?
parents.faq_1_a: The course is designed for children aged 10–12 — a time when they can read and express thoughts, but are still open to new thinking patterns. In the form you can select ages up to 14; the team will suggest the best group based on development level.
parents.faq_2_q: How much time does it take?
parents.faq_2_a: 3 months. Once a week — 2 lessons back-to-back (2 × 40 min). Between lessons the child plays the game 15–20 min a day. No notebooks, no written homework.
parents.faq_3_a: Your choice. Online runs on our own platform (not Zoom): interactive elements and detailed statistics. In-person in a classroom. Switch formats at any time — no extra charge.
parents.faq_4_q: How does the free trial work?
parents.faq_4_a: A manager calls within one business day to schedule a time. The first lesson is a full session with a trainer. Not happy? No obligations.
parents.faq_5_q: What if there's a power outage?
parents.faq_5_a: The lesson recording is always available. The game works offline: downloaded in advance, played without internet, then syncs when connection returns.
parents.faq_6_a: Payment is made by bank transfer to our current account no later than one day before the start.
parents.faq_7_a: The team behind the Soroban® international mental arithmetic school network — 10+ years, 10,000+ graduates, patents in the US and Japan. Syla Slova is built on the same pedagogy: small steps, daily practice, measurable results.

about.page_title: About — Syla Slova | Who Is Behind the Course
about.page_description: Yuriy Novosolov — founder of the Soroban® international school network, author of Syla Slova. 10+ years, 10,000+ graduates, patents in the USA and Japan.
about.hero_title: The person who created this course
about.hero_quote: This course is not about facts. It's about a skill that stays for life.
about.hero_quote_author: Yuriy Novosolov, founder of Syla Slova
about.founder_role: Founder of Syla Slova · Soroban® network
about.founder_bio_1: For over 10 years, Yuriy has been building the Soroban® international mental arithmetic school network — one of the largest children's education franchises in Eastern Europe, with thousands of graduates and patented methodology in the USA and Japan.
about.founder_bio_2: Syla Slova is his next step: a course designed on the same pedagogical principles — small steps, daily practice, measurable results — but aimed at a skill even more critical than arithmetic: the ability to think independently.
about.founder_bio_3: The course grew from a simple question: why do schools teach children what to think, but never teach them how? Every lesson, every episode of the game, every trainer session is an answer to that question.
about.mission_body: We live in an era where the volume of information doubles every two years. A child who can't tell fact from manipulation, can't resist group pressure, and can't ask the right questions — is vulnerable. Not because they're bad. Because no one taught them. Syla Slova fixes that.
about.method_title: The Soroban® approach, applied to thinking
about.method_1_body: Each of the 13 sessions introduces one precise skill. No overload, no rushing.
about.method_2_body: The game reinforces each lesson 15–20 minutes a day — without homework or pressure.
about.method_3_body: The parent dashboard shows exactly which skills the child has mastered. Not impressions — data.
about.soroban_body: Soroban® is an international mental arithmetic school network operating for 10+ years with over 10,000 graduates. The methodology is patented in the USA and Japan. Syla Slova uses the same approach — structured, step-by-step, results-driven — now applied to critical thinking.
